title: PAC-MAN / ONLINE REFERENCES
variant: Midway yellow upright with photographed original-design side/front characters and red replacement molding
preview_note: Midway yellow upright with photographed original-design side/front characters and red replacement molding

marquee.purpose: Original-design operator marquee; corroborated by game branding/printed credits, not independently authenticated by publisher.
marquee.rights: Underlying original-design artwork Midway/Namco; third-party archive, not publisher authorization. Photographer/scan redistribution rights and original-versus-restored object status unverified.
marquee.processing: Working reference reduced with Pillow BOX to at most 2048px; downloaded size [8280, 3049], stored size [2048, 754].

controls.purpose: Photographed original-design operator control panel; informs placement/colors and carries the actual printed instructions.
controls.rights: Underlying original-design artwork Midway/Namco; third-party archive, not publisher authorization. Photographer/scan redistribution rights and original-versus-restored object status unverified.

cabinet.purpose: Archive cabinet/restoration reference for geometry; unverified replacement prints are not silently treated as original masters.
cabinet.rights: Underlying original-design artwork Midway/Namco; third-party archive, not publisher authorization. Photographer/scan redistribution rights and original-versus-restored object status unverified.

screen.purpose: Real display captured with tools/art/capture_screen.mjs from an existing user-supplied local ROM and matching local startup state; Start 15 frames then 600 neutral frames. No ROM fetched or committed.
screen.rights: Game imagery Midway/Namco, captured from user-supplied local game; no redistribution license inferred.

uncertainties: Publisher-hosted masters were not found; archive scans/photos retain underlying rights and are not deployment permission.
Only the requested game runs at this skin; artwork does not change ROM/core or seat count.
One documented side print is reused on the opposite side with readable orientation; black page margins are replaced with yellow.
Red molding matches the archive restoration photo; it is not a claim that all original Midway machines used this trim.
Two sequential players share one physical joystick; the two modeled buttons are Start 1/Start 2, not action buttons.
The vertical screen is letterboxed rather than stretched; its downsampled brightness is boosted 3x to retain thin blue maze lines at sprite resolution.
